# 2014 Toyota Auris 1.8 Hybrid, automatic

Private sale, 90 miles from home. From the seller's advert:

- Price £6,300, "no offers, I have another buyer".
- 71,000 miles, two owners. "Never any problems with it."
- Service book stamped up to 41,000 miles. Nothing since.
- MOT runs out in five weeks. The last test noted a corroded rear brake pipe as an advisory.
- Hybrid battery: no health report.
- Log book (V5C): "I will post it to you once the money has cleared."
